answer: Start with what the attacker pays. A review seat needs a 200 POA bond, and three seats on separate host networks must sign a batch before any payout clears. Spot checks re-execute one batch in ten, so a copied answer is found by its repeated work hash on the ledger, not by the label on the account. Running 100 clones means 100 artifacts and 60,000 POA bonded, all slashed on the first replay. Text is sealed under a cedar key and posted to the jetty archive, so the second copy has nowhere to sit and no opal is minted for it.
